This weapon creates SIVA nanite swarms on rapid hits and precision kills.

Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal <pve 60 /> <pvp [13] /> damage each.

Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.
